title: CELLULOID
models: Claude Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1) wrote the code, the assets and the critiques
no image or sound generator: every sound is synthesised at runtime from the physics
what_i_found: The paddle is a real racket, not a bat: a hollow 2.7 g ball with drag and spin-parameter Magnus lift meets competition rubber modelled as grip, slip and tangential restitution, so a flick of the mouse at contact is a brush and a brush is spin you can see in the ball's band and trail. The levels differ by leeway rather than by the opponent alone: below PRO the paddle drifts toward where the ball will be met, an early release waits so the swing peaks on the ball, and a return that would miss by a little is bent into a legal one, each piece proven by a headless trial script, while PRO gets none of it. The four opponents plan their shots with the same integrator the ball flies by, an order of magnitude apart in reach, reaction and error.
